name: PipelineTerraformModulePublish
description: Publish a Terraform module version to HCP Terraform or a private Terraform registry
author: sethbacon

inputs.name: registryType
inputs.label: Registry type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target registry platform.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.label: Module namespace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Registry namespace. For HCP Terraform this is the organization name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Module name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Module name without the terraform-<provider>- prefix (e.g. networking-vpc).

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Provider / system
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target provider or system, e.g. aws, azurerm, google.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Semantic version to publish, e.g. 1.2.3.

inputs.name: registryUrl
inputs.label: Registry base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the private registry, e.g. https://registry.example.com.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Registry API key with modules:write scope. Pass a secret pipeline variable, e.g. $(tfregistry-api-key).

inputs.name: skipTlsVerify
inputs.label: Skip TLS verification
inputs.helpMarkDown: Disable TLS certificate verification. The apiKey is then sent over a connection whose server certificate is not authenticated, so it could be captured by an on-path attacker impersonating the registry. Honoured ONLY when registryUrl is, or resolves to, a private/link-local address -- the internal-registry case this exists for; it is refused against any destination that cannot be proven private. Installing that CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS is the first-class alternative and should be preferred.

inputs.name: scmProviderId
inputs.label: SCM provider ID (auto-create)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. UUID of a configured SCM provider connection in the registry. Set this together with repositoryOwner and repositoryName to auto-create and SCM-link a module that does not yet exist, instead of failing. Leave empty to require the module to be pre-registered.

inputs.name: repositoryOwner
inputs.label: Repository owner / project (auto-create)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Repository owner recorded on the SCM link when auto-creating a module. For Azure DevOps this is the project name; for GitHub/GitLab the org or user. Required only when auto-creating (with scmProviderId and repositoryName).

inputs.name: repositoryName
inputs.label: Repository name (auto-create)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Source repository name recorded on the SCM link when auto-creating a module. Required only when auto-creating (with scmProviderId and repositoryOwner).

inputs.name: defaultBranch
inputs.label: Default branch (auto-create)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Default branch recorded on the SCM link when auto-creating a module.

inputs.name: tagPattern
inputs.label: Tag pattern (auto-create)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Glob matched against git tags to import versions when auto-creating a module (default: v*).

inputs.name: hcpAddress
inputs.label: HCP / TFE address
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base address of HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.

inputs.name: hcpToken
inputs.label: HCP API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: HCP Terraform team or user API token. Pass a secret pipeline variable.

inputs.name: hcpPublishMode
inputs.label: Publish mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: How the version reaches HCP Terraform. 'auto' (default) follows the existing module: a module with no VCS connection receives an uploaded archive, a branch-based module has its version created from the commit, and a tag-based module is only observed (its versions come from git tags). When the module does not exist yet, 'auto' creates a VCS-connected branch module if both vcsRepoIdentifier and vcsOauthTokenId are set, a module with no VCS connection if neither is set, and fails if only one is set. Choose an explicit mode to require that kind of module; the task fails if the existing module is a different kind.

options.vcsBranch: VCS branch (create version from a commit)
options.vcsTag: VCS tag (versions come from git tags)

inputs.name: moduleDirectory
inputs.label: Module directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory archived and uploaded when the module has no VCS connection (upload mode). It must contain .tf or .tf.json files at its root. The .git and .terraform directories are excluded and symbolic links pointing outside the directory are refused. Not used for VCS modules.

inputs.name: moduleExclude
inputs.label: Exclude from archive
inputs.helpMarkDown: One path per line, relative to the module directory, left out of the uploaded archive in addition to .git and .terraform. A path may be a file or a directory; '*' matches within one path segment and '**' across segments (for example 'pipeline.yml', 'tests', '*.tfvars'). Used only when the module has no VCS connection.

inputs.name: existingVersion
inputs.label: When the version already exists
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when the version is already published and ready. 'skip' (default) succeeds without changing anything, which suits a re-run of a pipeline. 'fail' stops the task, which suits the first run of a release where an existing version means the number is already taken.

inputs.name: checkOnly
inputs.label: Check only (do not publish)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Read the module from HCP Terraform and report what a publish would do, without creating a module or version, deleting anything, or uploading. The inputs are still validated, and the module directory is still archived in memory to check it. Combine with 'When the version already exists: Fail' to stop a pipeline before it tags a release whose version is taken.

inputs.name: vcsRepoIdentifier
inputs.label: VCS repo identifier
inputs.helpMarkDown: Used only when creating a VCS-connected module that does not exist yet. Set together with the VCS OAuth connection ID. Leave both empty to create a module with no VCS connection instead. Example: my-org/my-project/_git/terraform-aws-vpc.

inputs.name: vcsBranch
inputs.label: VCS branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch for a VCS-connected module created in 'auto' or 'VCS branch' mode. Not used in 'VCS tag' mode, where the module follows git tags instead of a branch.

inputs.name: vcsOauthTokenId
inputs.label: VCS OAuth token ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: HCP VCS OAuth token ID (ot-xxxxxxxx). Required only when creating a new VCS-connected module; set together with vcsRepoIdentifier.

inputs.name: commitSha
inputs.label: Commit SHA
inputs.helpMarkDown: Commit SHA for the module version.

inputs.name: waitForPublish
inputs.label: Wait for version to be available
inputs.helpMarkDown: Poll the registry until the published version is available.

inputs.name: timeoutSeconds
inputs.label: Wait timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum time to wait for the version to become available.

messages.SkipTlsVerifyEnabled: skipTlsVerify is enabled: TLS certificate validation is DISABLED for the private registry connection, so the API key can be captured by an on-path attacker impersonating the registry. Use only for an internal registry fronted by a private CA the agent does not trust; prefer installing that CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS instead.
messages.SkipTlsVerifyPublicRegistryRejected: Refusing to disable TLS certificate validation (skipTlsVerify) against '%s': that destination is not provably private. skipTlsVerify is honoured only when registryUrl is a private/link-local/reserved address or resolves to one -- the case an internal registry fronted by a CA the agent does not trust actually is. The host is lowercased with a trailing dot stripped before the check (so 'app.terraform.io.' is the public registry, not a bypass), and a registryUrl that does not parse or that carries user:password@ credentials is refused outright. Install the private CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS instead of disabling verification.
messages.RegistryNonJsonResponse: Registry returned a non-JSON response body: %s
messages.HttpsRequired: Refusing to send credentials over a non-HTTPS URL (scheme '%s//' on host '%s'). Use an https:// URL.
messages.HcpVersionAlreadyReady: Version %s already exists and is ready.
messages.HcpVersionAlreadyReadyFail: Version %s already exists and is ready, and existingVersion is 'fail'. Choose a new version, or set existingVersion to 'skip' to treat this as already published.
messages.HcpCheckOnlyModuleMissing: Check only: module %s/%s/%s does not exist; a publish would create it as a '%s' module. Nothing was changed.
messages.HcpCheckOnlyVersionAbsent: Check only: version %s is not ready; a publish would create it on this '%s' module. Nothing was changed.
messages.HcpCheckOnlyFailed: Check only: could not read the module (HTTP %s), so nothing can be reported. Check the token and address.
messages.HcpPublishModeMismatch: hcpPublishMode is '%s' but module %s/%s/%s is a '%s' module. Set hcpPublishMode to match it, or to 'auto'.
messages.HcpVcsRepoNameMismatch: HCP names a VCS-connected module from its repository, so '%s' would create the module '%s' for provider '%s', not '%s' for provider '%s'. Set name and provider to match the repository (terraform-<provider>-<name>), or use a repository with the intended name.
messages.HcpVcsInputsIncomplete: Module does not exist and only one of vcsRepoIdentifier / vcsOauthTokenId is set; %s is missing. Set both to create a VCS-connected module, or neither to create a module with no VCS connection.
messages.HcpVcsModeNeedsInputs: hcpPublishMode '%s' needs both vcsRepoIdentifier and vcsOauthTokenId to create the module, which does not exist yet.
messages.HcpVcsBranchRequired: hcpPublishMode 'vcsBranch' needs vcsBranch to be set. Use 'vcsTag' for a tag-based module.
messages.HcpVcsInputsIgnored: hcpPublishMode is 'upload', so vcsRepoIdentifier / vcsOauthTokenId are ignored and the module is created with no VCS connection.
messages.HcpCreatingNoVcsModule: Module not found; creating module %s/%s/%s with no VCS connection.
messages.HcpModuleCreatedConcurrently: Module create returned HTTP %s, but the module now exists with the expected publishing mode; continuing.
messages.HcpTagBasedObserveOnly: Module %s/%s/%s is tag-based: versions are created by pushing a git tag, not through the API. Checking for version %s.
messages.HcpTagVersionNotPresent: Version %s is not present yet. Push the git tag to create it, or enable waitForPublish to wait for it.
messages.HcpRecreatingVersion: Version %s exists with status '%s' and can never become ready as it is; deleting and recreating it.
messages.HcpVersionInProgress: Version %s already exists with status '%s'; waiting for it instead of creating it again.
messages.HcpDeleteVersionFailed: Failed to delete the stuck version (HTTP %s): %s
messages.HcpNoUploadLink: HCP did not return an upload link for version %s of a module with no VCS connection.
messages.HcpNoUploadLinkWaiting: Version %s of a VCS-connected module is created from the commit, so no archive is uploaded.
messages.HcpUploadUrlInvalid: HCP returned an upload link that is not a valid https:// URL; refusing to upload to it.
messages.HcpUploadingArchive: Uploading module archive (%s bytes) for version %s.
messages.HcpVersionIngestFailed: HCP failed to process version %s (status '%s'). Check that the archive is a valid gzipped tar of the module.
messages.HcpCreatingVcsModule: Module not found; creating VCS-connected module %s/%s/%s.
messages.HcpCheckModuleFailed: Could not check existing module (HTTP %s); attempting to publish version.
messages.HcpWaitTimedOut: Timed out after %ss waiting for version %s to become ready.
messages.HcpPollingFailed: Polling version status failed, will retry: %s
messages.PrivateNoModuleId: Registry response did not include a module id.
messages.PrivateModuleIdInvalid: Registry returned a module id '%s' that is not a valid identifier; refusing to use it in an admin API request.
messages.PrivateWaitTimedOut: Timed out after %ss waiting for version %s to appear in the registry.
messages.PrivateVersionAvailable: Version %s is available in the registry.
messages.PrivateModuleNotFoundNoScmInputs: Module %s/%s/%s not found in the registry. Register and SCM-link the module before publishing, or set scmProviderId, repositoryOwner, and repositoryName to auto-create it.
messages.PrivateCreateResponseNoModuleId: Registry create response did not include a module id.
messages.PrivateVersionAlreadyPublished: Version %s of %s/%s/%s is already published in the registry; nothing to sync.
messages.PrivateSyncModuleNotLinked: Module %s/%s/%s exists but is not SCM-linked (an earlier run may have created it without linking it); linking it and retrying the sync.
messages.PrivatePollNonSuccess: Status poll returned HTTP %s; polling again in %ss.
